title: How Humanity Explained Disease Before Microbes

teenKit.tldr: How Humanity Explained Disease Before Microbes: Historical and clinical audit of pre-microbial disease ontologies, ranging from miasma theory and humoral imbalances to divine retribution. Integrates modern veterinary diagnostics, such as fructosami.
